_comment: Basic_Program round-trip regression portfolio. Feature-diverse minimum set covering every round-trip dimension the family exercises >=2x: single/multi-voice, legato/gated, play-once/loop, voiceless-const mask (bp_has_masks), freq-collision alphabet, start-frame offset, NTSC clock flag (60Hz). dur = songlength*1.1 (capped 120) = the family-batch verify window. Verdict = full SID->USF->SID round-trip FULL (pipelines.basic_program.usf_roundtrip.roundtrip).

portfolio.feat: single-voice gated play-once
legato single-voice
gated multi-voice loop + start-frame offset
voiceless-const mask + freq collision
freq-collision alphabet (coll=10) multi-voice
freq-collision alphabet (coll=2) long
NTSC clock flag (60Hz capture rate)
arpeggio (split into per-tick freq sub-steps)
consistent intra-step dup (unsplit derive_template; guards the split regression)
per-note instruments (running timbre via NoteRow.instr) + song-end (no false loop)
running-freq partial-freq notes (one freq byte carried) + timbre-only rest-step + const release ctrl
global automation track (cutoff sweep + filter mode/res/route + master-vol dynamics on the shared per-subtune global track)

looping tune recovered by the extend-and-verify path (rebuild runs ~1/rho slower so the fixed window cuts it mid-loop; verified by reproducing the orig's entire writelog as an exact prefix in an extended capture, no length tolerance)
min_trim verify-fallback: a complete final section (thinner texture) the aggressive trailing-trim would over-drop; kept via the masked path when min_trim verifies FULL
freq-hi-only writes (coarse pitch sweep, lo carried/unset) — running-freq seeded to the SID reset state (0) so a hi-only write resolves to (hi,0) instead of becoming a rest emitting freq-hi=$00

song-end silence: orig fades master-vol to $00 at the end (plays once); detect_song_end forces play-once (no false loop) and emits the captured song_end write sequence (bookend of init) at the player halt

per-frame PWM sweep-program engine: all 3 voices run an independent per-voice pulse-width automation orderlist (value-table + RLE (offset,len,repeats) sections, ledger C1) free-running at the BASIC-loop rate via the fractional-rate accumulator (mod_inc); notes re-timed onto the sweep-tick clock; PW emitted before the note check ([PW][note]). detect_modulation verify-fallback

gap-exactness / drift-free timing: a LONG tune (530+ steps) of back-to-back notes (gate-off frame == next gate-on frame) that the old max(1,nxt-off) gap floor inflated by +1 frame/step -> cumulative timing drift past the |len|<=64 tolerance, dropping the tail; recovered by the gap_exact lossless encoding (the length_fail-only 2nd-pass fallback in best_attempt). Guards the gap-floor regression

gap-floor-is-a-fallback guard: a tune whose rho-rounding COLLAPSED two distinct frames into nxt-off=0 (spurious back-to-back) -> the unconditional gap_exact (gap=0) REORDERED its same-frame writes (FULL->overlap_diverge). Stays FULL only because gap_exact is a length_fail-only 2nd-pass fallback, never the default. Guards against promoting gap_exact to the default encoding

too_few -> min_trim retry: a long heterogeneous tune (raw segment 474 steps) whose AGGRESSIVE trailing-trim drops it below 2 steps -> unsupported:too_few_after_trim. Recovered because best_attempt now retries the min_trim / force_split variants on too_few_* results (it previously fired fallbacks only on overlap_diverge/length_fail). Guards that too_few stays a retry candidate
